title: Unspoken Atlas
description: A datapack that slightly overhauls Minecraft
body:
Unspoken Atlas breathes new life into the Overworld by refining classic structures, adding massive new seafaring challenges, and fixing the "color vomit" of vanilla biomes for a more natural, cinematic look.
# 
🚀 **Key Features**

🏚️ **Abandoned Mineshaft Overhaul:** Completely redesigned mineshafts that actually look weathered and lived-in without being over-the-top. Includes logical loot tables that make sense for an abandoned dig site

🏴‍☠️ **Sunken Galleons:** A new massive, multi-decked shipwreck that is found in deep oceans, filled with valuable loot

🏘️ **Plains Village Tweaks:** A few small tweaks to certain buildings and decorations. Temple house completely redesigned to look like a proper church/townhall and villages now generate in forest biomes

🏛️ **Scattered Ruins:** New atmospheric structures including ruined small houses and crumbling towers found throughout the Overworld

🌿 **Miscellaneous Biome Tweaks:** Tweaks colors of the jungle and cherry grove biome to look more aesthetically pleasing/more natural and ocean biomes share a more unified dark blue color to remove that color vomit look. Also reduced glow lichen in caves
## 

This datapack is an active work-in-progress. I am constantly learning and plan to add even more features, such as custom Overworld biomes and maybe an End Island update. Expect features to evolve as the project grows!

Discord: discord.gg/uy3Jqma6Xu

For the best experience, I highly recommend using Unspoken Atlas alongside these fantastic packs:

・Tectonic — For massive, flowing terrain.

・Better Trees — For more realistic forest canopies.
